caller_is_validator.meaning: the caller of the batch settlement function holds the validator role

standard_flows_kyc_gated.meaning: standard transfer/transferFrom/mint/burn paths revert for non-KYC recipients (and holders)

validator_compromised.meaning: the validator exercising the privileged batch functions is compromised or malicious

recipient_is_kyc_verified.meaning: the batch settlement recipient/creditor is marked isKycVerified

funds_routed_to_unverified.meaning: a single validator call routes funds to an unverified or sanctioned destination, nullifying the on-chain KYC compliance invariant

assumptions: The validator role is a single privileged key able to invoke batchTransfers/rBatchTransfers.
The batch settlement recipient is a non-KYC or sanctioned address (recipient_is_kyc_verified false).
Standard transfer paths enforce the KYC gate as described; the batch path is the bypass under analysis.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish a concrete prior transaction or specific KYC-verified balance before the batch call; the routing is formalized at the observable outcome level.

limitations: Formalizes only the KYC-bypass impact; the pause-bypass and regulatory-risk impacts are handled in separate passes.
The KYC gate is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric definition of the verification predicate.
